title: `--allow-inconclusive` does not reach an unperformed method
note: The twin of the case above, and the one that makes it mean something. §2 scopes the flag to `verification/timeout` and `verification/unsupported-construct`; an unperformed method is neither, so the exit code is 2 with the flag exactly as it is without it, and there is no `--allow-unperformed`.
